white_keys.label: C
white_keys.title: Classical & Calculus
white_keys.body: Before coming to the US at 17, I've already enjoyed learning classical piano at Vietnam National Academy of Music for 9 years and solved challenging math problems at Chu Van An High School for the Gifted - Math Specialized Class.

white_keys.label: D
white_keys.title: Departure
white_keys.body: I left Vietnam to study at Dickinson College for my Bachelor's in the United States and open my horizon.

white_keys.label: E
white_keys.title: Education
white_keys.body: At Dickinson College, I doubled major in Quantitative Economics and Music Performance where I enjoyed studying and challenging myself with hackathons, Econ Games, Recitals, and Concerto Competition.

white_keys.label: F
white_keys.title: First Wons
white_keys.body: I won the Concerto Competition, performing Grieg's Piano Concerto in A minor and landed my first Data Analyst Internship in the States where I learned tremendously as a performer and a team contributor working with real-world data!

white_keys.label: G
white_keys.title: Growth
white_keys.body: After graduating with Summa Sum Laude, I started working at Bank of America as a Technology Analyst and performed with the NY Piano Society. After 2 years, I got promoted to SWE II and was honored to perform at Carnegie Hall.

white_keys.label: A
white_keys.title: Ambition
white_keys.body: After 3 years in the field, I helped my company built an automatic repair tools that fixed millions of trading messages to comply with FINRA, saving an estimated $2.5 million dollars. However, I was still hunger for innovation and the impact we could do with data. I decided to pursue a master's in Data Science at NYU, studying how AI reshapes what's been impossible in Music and other high-stake fields such as healthcare or education.

white_keys.label: B
white_keys.title: Building
white_keys.body: Since then, I have been thinking hard about these lingering questions. I have built a little passion e-comerce project on jewlery database and machine-learning powered platofrm, MCP-powered tools to catch AI red-handed on enabling users to copyright laundering, and utilized a deep learning framework to empower researchers to classifying microglia on images and answer the unknown.

black_keys.label: C♯
black_keys.title: ♯ The Leap
black_keys.body: Wanted something practical with my math background, I researched schools domestically and in the U.S. to maximize my potential.

black_keys.label: D♯
black_keys.title: ♯ Direction
black_keys.body: I chose Quantitative Economics so that I could apply my problem solving skills into solving economic matters with quantitative methods.

black_keys.label: F♯
black_keys.title: ♯ First Step
black_keys.body: I interned as a Data Analyst at a Technology startup - InfoRe Technology (2019), then a private equity firm - Mekong Capital (2020), exposing myself to the industry. During those 2 years, I competed in the Concerto Competition but fell short of first place.

black_keys.label: G♯
black_keys.title: ♯ Scale
black_keys.body: I got accepted for my first job at Bank of America as a Business Analyst!

black_keys.label: A♯
black_keys.title: ♯ Converge
black_keys.body: I'm still performing, still shipping code. The two tracks aren't merging, yet they're sharpening each other.

cta_key.label: C
cta_key.title: Calling
cta_key.body: I want build products that inspire creators, amplify their artistry, and stick with them something meaningful after they left.
